app.name: Clinics Platform
app.tagline: Cloud management for clinics and medical centers in Egypt and Saudi Arabia

phase.title: System status
phase.description: Public page that checks the frontend, API and database are connected. This is a development environment and contains no real patient data.

status.title: System status
status.degraded: Running, but the database is unavailable

specialties.title: Initial specialties
specialties.note: Synthetic reference data from the database
specialties.empty: No specialties yet. Run npm run seed to initialize the data.

footer.devOnly: Development environment — not a production build.

auth.registerSubtitle: Create your account, then add your first organization.
auth.verificationNote: Email verification and password recovery are not available yet in this phase.

onboarding.title: Set up your organization
onboarding.subtitle: Welcome {{name}}. Add your clinic or medical center and its first branch. You will be the owner.
onboarding.branchHint: You can add more branches later.

access.deniedBody: Your role in this organization does not include this page. Ask an owner or admin if you need access.
access.orgUnavailableBody: You may not be a member of this organization, or your membership was suspended.

home.allBranchesSelected: Showing all branches. Pick a branch at the top to focus on it.
home.countsDefinition: Actual counts of appointments starting today, by their current status, within the branches you can access.

branches.title: Branches
branches.readOnlyNote: You can view the branches available to you.
branches.empty: No branches are available to you.
branches.name: Branch name

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Organization members, their roles and the branches each one can access.
team.orgWideNote: Owners and admins always have access to all branches.
team.addHint: Enter the full email of someone who already has an account. No email invitations are sent in this phase; if they have no account, ask them to register first.
team.suspendedNotice: {{name}}'s membership was suspended. They can no longer access the organization.

settings.title: Organization settings
settings.timeZoneHint: Working hours and appointments are interpreted in this zone. It cannot change while future appointments exist.
settings.timeZoneMissing: No time zone is set yet. Choose one to enable schedules and appointments.

profile.title: Profile
profile.emailUnverified: Not verified (verification is not available yet)

notFound.body: The link you opened doesn't exist or has moved.

patients.title: Patients
patients.subtitle: Administrative patient registry for the branches you can access.
patients.newHint: Only the name, a phone number with its country and a branch are required. No medical information is recorded here.
patients.branchFilterNote: Showing patients registered at {{branch}} only. Choose “All branches” at the top to see everyone.
patients.fullNameHint: Saved exactly as typed (Arabic or English).
patients.phoneHint: Choose the country for a local number, or type the international number with +. Arabic digits are accepted.
patients.duplicateWarning: A patient with the same name and phone number exists. It may be the same person, or another family member. Check the record before continuing.
patients.createAnyway: I'm sure — register a new patient
patients.sharedIdentityNote: These details are shared by every branch of this organization where the patient is registered; changes appear in all of them.
patients.registrationsHint: Archiving stops new bookings at that branch without deleting the record or past appointments.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.truncated: Too many results; narrow the period or use the filters.
appointments.finalState: This appointment is final and stays in the record.

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.chooseFirst: Choose a branch, doctor and date to see available times.
booking.noSlots: No available times on this day.
booking.repeatedHourHint: Some times occur twice on this day because of the daylight-saving change; the UTC offset next to them tells them apart.
booking.notRegisteredHere: The patient has no active registration at this branch. Register them there from their record first.

queue.title: Today's queue
queue.subtitle: Waiting patients are ordered by actual arrival time, then appointment time. Refreshes automatically.

practitioners.title: Doctors & schedules
practitioners.subtitle: Scheduling profiles of the organization's doctors.
practitioners.addTitle: Scheduling profile for a doctor member
practitioners.addHint: The profile belongs to an active member with the doctor role; no new login account is created.
practitioners.empty: No doctors are available to you.
practitioners.emptyManage: No scheduling profiles yet. Add one for a doctor member.
practitioners.noCandidates: Every doctor member already has a profile. Add a member with the doctor role on the Team page.

schedule.weeklyHint: Intervals may not overlap, not even across different branches.
schedule.exceptionsHint: Close a day or replace a branch's hours on a given date. Changes that conflict with booked appointments are refused.
